reviews.title: Excellent quality
reviews.body: We ordered 8 of these chairs.  2 boxes of  4 - 30"  to go with my bar height  dining room table . They are a big hit . They were very well  packaged. The additional screws and foot pads are a nice thing to have around.  The included tools are of excellent quality.  They didnt skimp with cheap aluminum tools that are generally included for assembly.They are sturdy .the seats are attractive & adequate.  was disappointed  its fiberboard with a laminate and not hardwood  as they say in the add ..BUT.. as long as you follow the manufacturer's guidelines  of DO NOT USE THEM OUTSIDE  . You'll be fine . It's well done and a nice application,  I foresee no problems.  I saw that many purchasers  put them outside then couldnt figure out why the seats went to pot ..well .. it clearly says DO NOT USE STOOLS OUTSIDE.. seats will warp split and peel even in mild conditions.  They arent made for the outdoors.  Again ..as it clearly says : INSIDE USE ONLY.They hold considerable weight and there is no rocking  or any cases of them being unlevel.  The black finish  is a nice matt black  . The seat is wide & roomy . That's nice . Everyone seems comfortable.  They love  the additional support bars under the seat that adds to their stability.One was dinged during shipping  but causes no real grief and not woth the nightmare of doing a return for a single stool . It should make no difference structurally  . I have  built furniture for decades.  It is bound to happen on occasion.  (Photo included)I'd highly recommend these stools . They should last a lifetime if cared for and used as intended.  Would purchase again.

reviews.title: Pretty good, all things considered.
reviews.body: If you keep in mind what you are paying for - these are actually pretty good.They came well packaged, with no damage. Assembly was easy (4 long screws for the back, and 4 short screws for the seat, per chair), and they look really nice (I got the ones that are black with a dark walnut colored seat).They are quite sturdy, and are exactly as described on the product listing. Easy 1 person no-tool (Allen wrench only) assembly. Maybe 20 mins per chair if you are healthy and flexible.They are hard wood stools, so not the most comfy for the skinny folks among us - but they are no less comfy than any other hard stools/chairs. It's par for the course, and you can remedy with a pillow. I would say they are probably slightly "more" comfy than your average hard stool once you sit farther back.The seat is not huge, but it is an adequate size. The back is not bad, and serves its purpose.These chairs will stack - IF you don't have the backs on them. Just an important note I saw some confusion over in other places.The one negative I have seen with these is the seat finish. The wood (or whatever this is) is stained, but the stain/finish was not applied properly. The finish is rough and finely bumpy in some areas, almost like a super fine grit sandpaper. I worry about someone sitting on them with a delicate dress or outfit, and the seat damaging or causing pulls in the fabric. If I had some time on my hands - I would try to sand them down and refinish them myself, but that's not worth it for me. I think the seats will be fine for 90% of daily fabrics. I plan to keep them  - as it's not bad enough for a return. It just is a reminder they these are lower quality pieces.I will add that based on the material - these are strictly indoor only. You might be able to get away with under an umbrella outside - but sun and moisture will wreck these. They're plenty durable enough for indoors though.So, 1 star loss for the super fine grit sandpaper seat - but everything else is pretty good.

reviews.title: To help all others!
reviews.body: I really wanted to write a review to help any others out there that need aid with what height of stool to get lolFirst off, the shipping was quick, given the pandemic and the delivery services being on all sorts of delays, I ordered these and received a week later, which in my opinion isn't bad at all!Secondly, they are wonderful quality, and in the budget for just about anyone. they came looking just like the photo, black stool, with dark brown wood seating area. I did the assembly myself, all the screws and tool to screw them in were included and in order, and it took about 5 minutes per seat, so Overall I was done and they were at the bar in 20 minutes!Third, I struggled SO badly to decide on the height I needed for my grill bar area outside, but to help anyone who doesn't know (like how I was before doing my research) The recommended space between your counter and seat is 10 inches. So for example, Measuring my counter height on my outdoor bar, it measures 37" High, subtract 10", and that gives you 27", and since they dont make 27" high stools, I figured 1" wouldn't hurt, so I purchased the 26” height ones here, and after seating at the bar it really is perfect! I love that I was able to get a pack of 4 stools for such a deal price! they fit my counter/bar area so nicely and it's making my outdoor space that much more enjoyable! Definitely recommend, the style is great, and you really can't beat the price! Edited to add, it’s also good height for children to seat as well as adults! I’ve attached photos of the overall look, the seat wood color, and what it looks like for the adult to seat, and how children look seating, and my 9 year old sons growth is a bit on the small end so that shows how well it accommodates seating for all sizes. Hope it helps!
